bullets.text: Heavy rain warnings have been issued for Velachery where boats are being prepared, and the office should monitor flood readiness and waterlogging.
Residents have raised safety concerns as silt cleared from canals and stormwater drains is left piled along roadsides in Velachery, requiring local clearance monitoring.
A car lost control and met with an accident in Velachery, and the office should track traffic safety measures in the area.
The Greater Chennai Corporation has deployed drones and control rooms in Thiruvallur zones for heavy rain surveillance, and the office should oversee flood response.
A 10-foot sinkhole appeared on a TTP road in Ambattur disrupting traffic, and the office should ensure the Water Board expedites repairs.
Aavin has invited e-tenders for producing sweets at its Ambattur dairy farm, and the portfolio team should monitor contract awards.
MeitY secretary S Krishnan reported that 303 government websites are vulnerable to PHP flaws, and the department must audit state portals immediately.
Telangana launched an AI avatar of its IT minister, and the digital services team should review similar citizen interface innovations for Tamil Nadu.
MeitY has directed industry bodies to strengthen security audits, and our IT department should coordinate compliance checks across digital infrastructure.
Reports highlighted an event involving actor Dhanush on land owned by a minister's family, and the office should watch political reactions closely.
